verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI can run CPU-only ('No GPU required', a CPU path for every feature) and auto-detects GPUs to pick a backend. Nothing documents splitting a model across GPU VRAM and system RAM, such as partial layer offload, to run models larger than available VRAM. Distributed GPU worker nodes are a different capability and cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
